title: PRD-03 synthetic risk input syntax

motorcycleRef.description: required; authorized asset record. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: MOTORCYCLE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

engineCapacityCc.description: conditional by form; 1–100000 technical bound, not eligibility. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ENGINE_CAPACITY_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

powertrainCode.description: required; carrier-mapped code <= 40. Sensitivity: internal. Error: POWERTRAIN_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

modelYear.description: required; explicit calendar; four digits after conversion. Sensitivity: internal. Error: MODEL_YEAR_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

usageCode.description: required; private/commercial classifications are carrier-owned. Sensitivity: internal. Error: USAGE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

priorPolicyRef.description: optional; permission-checked document reference. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PRIOR_POLICY_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

liabilityPlanCode.description: required; 1–40 characters from published plan. Sensitivity: internal. Error: PLAN_NOT_OFFERED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
